I can't provide real-time weather updates, but you can check the current weather in your location using a weather app or website like:

- **Weather.com** ([www.weather.com](https://weather.com))
- **AccuWeather** ([www.accuweather.com](https://www.accuweather.com))
- **The Weather Channel app** (available on iOS and Android)
